How Model Status Works & Step-by-Step Server Mapping Guide

When you deploy LLMs or speech models on your own servers (e.g., bare-metal GPU boxes, private Kubernetes clusters, or cloud VMs running vLLM, Ollama, or LM Studio), the platform needs two pieces of configuration to probe them and report their real status on this screen.

Step 1: Map Your Engine Server URL in AiProviderConnection

Database or UI /ai-providers

The platform probe aggregator (apps/text) calls POST /api/v1/providers/probe using the addresses resolved by resolveConnection('llm', provider, SYSTEM_TENANT_ID). To point an engine to your private server, add or update the connection row in PostgreSQL table core.ai_provider_connections or via AI Platform $ ightarrow$ AI Providers: 

-- SQL mapping to point vLLM or Ollama to your server IP/Port:
INSERT INTO core.ai_provider_connections (
  id, service, provider, tenant_id, base_url, is_enabled, source
) VALUES 
  (gen_random_uuid(), 'llm', 'vllm',      'SYSTEM', 'http://YOUR_SERVER_IP:8000/v1',  true, 'system'),
  (gen_random_uuid(), 'llm', 'ollama',    'SYSTEM', 'http://YOUR_SERVER_IP:11434',    true, 'system'),
  (gen_random_uuid(), 'llm', 'lm-studio', 'SYSTEM', 'http://YOUR_SERVER_IP:1234/v1',  true, 'system')
ON CONFLICT (service, provider, tenant_id) 
DO UPDATE SET base_url = EXCLUDED.base_url, is_enabled = true;

Step 2: Verify Your Server Exposes the Standard Probe Endpoints

apps/text expects OpenAI-compatible or engine-native endpoints to probe uptime and enumerate loaded models:

Engine Provider Required Server Endpoint Probe Contract Checked What Determines "Up" vs "Down"
vllm GET http://YOUR_SERVER:8000/v1/models OpenAI Model List Format HTTP 200 with data[0].id containing model name $ ightarrow$ marked Up (1/1 loaded).
ollama GET http://YOUR_SERVER:11434/api/tags
GET http://YOUR_SERVER:11434/api/ps		 Ollama Native Tags & Process HTTP 200 $ ightarrow$ lists available tags and verifies active VRAM residency via /api/ps.
lm-studio GET http://YOUR_SERVER:1234/v1/models OpenAI Compatible + LMStudio SDK HTTP 200 $ ightarrow$ reads loaded/not-loaded state from LM Studio daemon.
llama-cpp GET http://YOUR_SERVER:8080/health llama.cpp HTTP Health HTTP 200 {"status":"ok"} $ ightarrow$ marked Up (single dedicated model).

Step 3: Register Your Model in the Catalogue (core.ai_models)

For the Model readiness section to show Ready (green), the model slug or sourceUri in core.ai_models must match the string returned by your server's /v1/models: 

-- Register the exact model running on your server:
INSERT INTO core.ai_models (
  id, name, slug, source_uri, task_type, provider, deployment_kind, resource_status, tenant_id
) VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  'Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct',
  'meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct',
  'meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct',  -- Must match /v1/models id
  'text-generation',
  'vllm',
  'SERVER_MANAGED',
  'ENABLED',
  'SYSTEM'
);
💡 Rule: If the engine answers "Up" but your model is not listed in its /v1/models, status shows Weights missing. If listed and resident, it displays Ready.

Step 4: Microservice Base URLs (apps/api Environment Variables)

For the Platform microservices tiles (guardrail, nlp, stt, tts, text), configure your server environment variables in apps/api (or Kubernetes Deployment):

TEXT_URL=http://YOUR_SERVER:8862
GUARDRAIL_URL=http://YOUR_SERVER:8863
NLP_URL=http://YOUR_SERVER:8864
STT_URL=http://YOUR_SERVER:8865
TTS_URL=http://YOUR_SERVER:8867
HARNESS_URL=http://YOUR_SERVER:8866

⚡ Developer Quick Start & SDK Guide

/developer · apps/admin-console/src/features/developer-docs · Business & Admin Planes
👈 Click any credential or error code to inspect gateway contract
Quick Call via cURL GET /api/v1/consultations 
curl -X GET "$HOPE_API_URL/api/v1/consultations" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $HOPE_API_KEY"

Authenticates with tenant-scoped API Key. Reaches business-plane endpoints; returns JSON list of consultation encounters.

🔐 Authentication Options

VOX Gateway supports User JWTs (browser), API keys (business plane server-to-server), and Service-Account Tokens (OAuth2 client credentials with explicit scopes).

Bearer <token> X-API-Key X-Service-Account-Token
⚠️ Healthcare Error Contract

Every non-2xx response is a standardized JSON error with machine-readable code, request tracing ID, and optimistic concurrency If-Match guidance.

401 Unauthorized 403 Forbidden 412 Precondition
TypeScript / Node.js SDK Usage npm i @arcaai/vox-node 
import { HopeClient } from '@arcaai/vox-node';

const hope = new HopeClient({
  baseUrl: process.env.HOPE_API_URL,
  apiKey: process.env.HOPE_API_KEY,
});

// Fetch active clinical encounters
const consultations = await hope.consultations.list({
  departmentId: 'dep_cardio_01',
  status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
});

// Stream transcription session
const session = await hope.transcription.createSession({
  encounterId: consultations.data[0].id,
  language: 'en-US',
  enableDiarization: true,
});
Python SDK Usage pip install arcaai-vox-python 
from arcaai_vox import VoxClient

client = VoxClient(
    base_url="https://api.vox.hospital.internal",
    api_key="hope_live_9a8f..."
)

# Invoke clinical scribe workflow directly
result = client.workflows.invoke(
    workflow_slug="consultation-clinical-pipeline",
    context={
        "patientId": "pt_882910",
        "chiefComplaint": "Shortness of breath on mild exertion",
        "vitals": {"hr": 88, "bp": "130/84", "spo2": 97}
    }
)
print("Generated SOAP:", result.document.soap_note)
Credential Class Header Format Plane Reach Lifecycle & Security Note
User JWT Authorization: Bearer <token> Both Planes Issued by login flow. Short-lived (15 min); refreshed via HTTP-only cookie by console.
API Key X-API-Key: <key> Business Plane Only Rejected with 403 on every /admin route before scopes are evaluated. Hash stored in DB.
Service-Account Token X-Service-Account-Token: <token> Both Planes (Scoped) Exchanged from client credentials (~15 min). Tenant binds at exchange; do not send X-Tenant-Id.
Status Code Canonical Meaning in HOPE Architecture
401 Unauthorized No credential was provided, or token is expired, revoked, or signature fails verification.
403 Forbidden A privilege boundary — credential class, scope, or ABAC patient consent is insufficient.
404 Not Found Not found — or belongs to another tenant. Gateway hides existence across tenants ("not yours").
409 Conflict State conflict, commonly a tenant quota ceiling reached from subscription plan entitlements.
412 Precondition Failed Your If-Match no longer matches current ETag. Re-read the resource before retrying write.
428 Precondition Required Route requires If-Match and none was sent. Read resource, take its ETag, resend.
429 Too Many Requests Rate limit exceeded. Check Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset response headers.
Generate Type-Safe Context DTOs npx @arcaai/vox codegen 
# Fetch tenant-pinned schema and emit TypeScript interfaces
npx @arcaai/vox codegen \
  --schema general-medicine-context \
  --out src/types/clinical-context.ts

SUBJECTIVE
Patient reports resolution of daytime resting angina following metoprolol titration. Continues to note mild exertional dyspnea with stairs (NYHA II). Denies orthopnea, PND, or edema.
OBJECTIVE
BP: 132/84 mmHg, HR: 68 bpm regular, SpO2: 98% room air. Heart: Regular rate and rhythm, no S3/S4 murmurs. Lungs clear bilaterally.
ASSESSMENT & CODING

2. Chronic Ischemic Heart Disease (I25.10) with mild exertional dyspnea.

1. Continue Metoprolol Succinate 50 mg daily, Lisinopril 10 mg daily.
2. Order Transthoracic Echocardiogram (TTE). Follow-up in 6 weeks.
